tasks.title: The next contract patch validates notify inputs with notify's rules and correct UTF-16 report limits
tasks.spec: ## Repository: contract, R1-R6, Tests items 1-6, Baseline rule and all Completion evidence; Required behavior R1-R6; Evidence and Counterexamples; Security impact; Performance impact; Acceptance evidence 1-4,8. Write public-validator tests first on unchanged src/notify-channels.ts (b637302 or later main, equal to c5ce668): every runtime defect in items 1-4 fails by assertion, all controls and hostile-input checks pass. Then change only viewText to refine string.length for its six positions; use notify 0464b90's anchored envelopeAddress extraction plus trimming; use its private isEhloName predicate while keeping text's 200-code-point cap; add both never-view rules in R4's issue order. Cover all boundaries, reused/nested validators, from/to[0], identity, absent clientName, actual NUL and never/fresh/stale cases. Preserve unrelated validators, existing messages, getter safety, never-throw/same-object guarantees, dependencies, exports and WIRE_VERSION 1. Complete all R5 docs bullets; package.json version only becomes 2.5.1 on today's 2.5.0 main or the next free patch after main if #823 merges first. Rebuild and commit dist/notify-channels.js and the .d.ts only if the build changes it. Record test CPU and build CPU A/B, not wall times. Contract merges first; consumers follow the readers-first rollout.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; package.json and committed bun.lock agree.

After implementation, 0 fail. Items 1-4: every defect case fails by assertion on unchanged source and every control passes there; after the patch all pass. R1 covers all six 200/300-unit fields with 200/300 accept, 202/302 emoji reject, empty reject and mixed 200/201 boundaries; also nested service.report.fileChannels[0].refs[0] in the admin channels view and failed[0].key in the failed view, with Counterexamples' literal errors. R2/R3 cover every Evidence/Counterexamples row for from and to[0], trailing/pulse_console also through record/admin paths, Object.is for accepts with original spelling, actual U+0000, absent clientName, the 191-character accept and intentional 255-character rejection with must be at most 200 characters. R4 gives exactly view.failed: must be empty when state is never for [entry]/1 and [entry]/0, and view.failedTotal: must be 0 when state is never for []/3; never/null/[]/0, fresh and stale controls pass. Existing empty/CRLF/cap rejects and unchanged accepts pass on both versions. Both 100000-character hostile inputs in item 6 reject without throwing, each under 50 ms. Focused coverage failure is not a failing test; the coverage gate belongs to the full suite.
exit 0; lint, build, typecheck and full tests pass, including getter safety, adversarial inputs and dist smoke checks; the existing 80% line coverage gate passes.

acceptance.command: bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist
acceptance.expected: exit 0 after rebuilt artifacts are committed; another build produces no tracked dist changes.

src/index.ts has no diff. package.json changes only the version line, 2.5.0 to 2.5.1 on today's main or main's version to the next free patch literal independently established from main and named in the PR. No export or dependency change.
Prints literal 2.5.1, or the next free patch literal independently established from main per Goal/R6 and named in the PR; no backwards or minor version change.
0 fail; existing WIRE_VERSION === 1 assertion remains true. Focused global coverage status is not the test result.

All R5 bullets are present: NotifyFailedEvent with the eight literal NOTIFY_FAILED_EVENTS values and ResendCommandState with the nine literal RESEND_COMMAND_STATES values; six report text positions count UTF-16 units while the section's other text limits count code points; never means null receivedAt, empty failed and zero failedTotal; final angle-bracket extraction and trimming, ASCII hostname/address-literal clientName rule with the existing 200 cap, and chosen patch literal with wire version 1.

Performance impact: run five samples per side, alternating origin/main and branch with the matching dependencies installed; all full test runs pass. Report median user + system seconds per side and their delta in the PR, never substitute wall time. Expected test CPU increase about 0.1 s. A test CPU increase above 0.5 s is reported as a finding (Acceptance evidence 8).

Performance impact: three alternating origin/main/branch samples per side; builds pass. Report median user + system seconds per side and delta in the PR; expected no measurable build CPU change (<0.1 s).
exit 0; all required repository CI checks pass.

Includes each items 1-4 defect's failing assertion on unchanged source, every control passing there and all passing after the patch; the full R2/R3 Evidence table run through public validateNotifyChannelDefinition with the independent notify 0464b90 boolean per row; docs/release/unchanged WIRE_VERSION and exports/dependencies/dist evidence. Includes test CPU A/B (five alternating samples per side) and build CPU A/B (three), medians/deltas and findings. Includes applicable Security impact checklist: trust-boundary input/getter safety; fixed secret-free errors; UTF-16/body limits; hostile-input timings; unchanged dependencies/exports.
